verdict.rationale: Token2 supports exporting TOTP seeds as open CSV/JSON files for Entra ID import, and its open-source fido2-manage tool lets users list, download, and rehydrate resident credentials and SSH keys from FIDO2 devices, plus it's explicitly manufacturer-agnostic (works with any FIDO2.1 key), supporting migration away from Token2 hardware without lock-in. However, this covers only specific data types (TOTP seeds, credentials, SSH keys) rather than a full account/data export, and there's no unified 'export everything' feature or documentation. Missing for 10: comprehensive account-wide data export, first-party documentation framing this as a full data portability/exit feature, independent verification of export completeness.
